alabama.how: Alabama sells state surplus to the public through online auctions after eligible agencies and nonprofits have had first pick.

alaska.how: Alaska's State Surplus Property Program lets residents bid on property the state no longer needs. Vehicles and heavy equipment are sold separately by the transportation department's State Equipment Fleet.

arizona.how: Arizona's Surplus Property Management Office sells to the public through an online auction. You create an account on the auction site the state links to.

arkansas.how: Arkansas State Surplus, also called Marketing and Redistribution, sells to the public at a weekly public sale day at its warehouse and through online auctions.

california.how: California's Department of General Services runs an online state surplus property auction. Anyone can register as a bidder.

colorado.how: In Colorado, state surplus property is handled by Colorado Correctional Industries, which links to the state's online surplus and fleet vehicle auctions.

connecticut.how: Connecticut's Department of Administrative Services sells state surplus to the public through online auctions.

delaware.how: Delaware Surplus Services handles state surplus property.

florida.how: Florida's Department of Management Services auctions surplus state vehicles and mobile equipment to the public.
florida.land_label: Florida Department of Environmental Protection: surplus state lands for sale

georgia.how: Georgia's Department of Administrative Services Surplus Property Division handles state and federal surplus.

hawaii.how: Hawaii's Surplus Property Office sells to the public through online auctions on a state auction site.

idaho.how: Idaho's Federal Surplus Property Program explains that federal property not donated to eligible groups is sold to the public through GSA Auctions. State agencies sell their own surplus through online auctions.

illinois.how: Illinois sells state surplus to the public on iBid, the state's own online auction site, run by Central Management Services.

indiana.how: Indiana's Department of Administration sells surplus to the public through online auctions and sealed bids, with separate pages for vehicle auctions and surplus real estate.
indiana.land_label: Indiana Department of Administration: surplus real estate sales

iowa.how: Iowa's Department of Administrative Services sells state surplus, other than real estate, through online auctions run by a contractor.

kansas.how: Kansas lists surplus for public sale online. Its federal surplus program does not hold live auctions.

kentucky.how: Kentucky's Division of Surplus Properties runs both the state and federal surplus programs and holds public auctions, including online auctions of transportation equipment.

louisiana.how: The Louisiana Property Assistance Agency tracks state movable property and sells or auctions what agencies no longer need.

maine.how: Maine Surplus sells through a monthly public sale at its Augusta warehouse and through online auctions.

maryland.how: Maryland's Department of General Services sells state surplus through online auctions open to the public.

massachusetts.how: Massachusetts offers surplus first to state departments, then to cities, towns, and qualified nonprofits, and then to the public through online auctions.

michigan.how: Michigan sells state surplus on MiBid, the state's own online auction site.

minnesota.how: Minnesota sells state surplus on MNbid, the state's official auction website.

mississippi.how: The Mississippi Office of Surplus Property serves governments and nonprofits and sells state surplus through online auctions.

missouri.how: Missouri's State Agency for Surplus Property invites the public to bid in its online auctions.

montana.how: Montana's Surplus Property and Recycling program runs the state and federal surplus programs and sells to the public through an online auction.

nebraska.how: Nebraska's Materiel Division Surplus Property office processes and sells state surplus.

nevada.how: Nevada's State Purchasing Division reallocates usable state property and sells the rest at auction.
nevada.land_label: Nevada Department of Transportation: surplus property for sale

new-hampshire.how: New Hampshire Surplus, known as White Farm, is the state's reuse center for state and federal surplus and holds periodic public auctions.

new-jersey.how: New Jersey's Distribution and Support Services, in the Treasury Department, sells surplus state vehicles and property through public and online auctions.

new-mexico.how: New Mexico's State Agency for Surplus Property redistributes state and federal surplus to eligible groups and sells to the public.

new-york.how: New York's Office of General Services sells state surplus through online auctions. You preregister before bidding.
new-york.land_label: New York Office of General Services: real estate auctions

north-carolina.how: North Carolina's State Surplus Property Agency sells through retail sales and online bidding.

north-dakota.how: North Dakota State Surplus Property distributes surplus to eligible organizations and sells state surplus to the public.

ohio.how: In Ohio the public can bid on state surplus, including vehicles, through online auctions after registering as a bidder.

oklahoma.how: Oklahoma Surplus sells state-owned items, from computers to cars, mainly through online auctions.

oregon.how: Oregon's State Surplus Property program sells through online auctions. Some bidders must be pre-qualified by the program first.

pennsylvania.how: Pennsylvania's Department of General Services sells surplus supplies, equipment, and vehicles through an online auction marketplace.

rhode-island.how: Rhode Island's Division of Capital Asset Management and Maintenance repurposes surplus between agencies and sells the rest through online auctions.

south-carolina.how: South Carolina's Surplus Property Office runs a retail store at its West Columbia warehouse and sells through public auctions and sealed bids.
south-carolina.land_label: South Carolina Department of Administration: state surplus real property list

south-dakota.how: South Dakota Property Management holds live surplus auctions around the state and lists online auctions.

tennessee.how: Tennessee State Surplus sells to local governments, nonprofits, and the public through an online auction.

texas.how: The Texas Facilities Commission runs a State Surplus Store in Austin that is open to the public, plus online auctions.

utah.how: Utah State Surplus Property offers items to government agencies first, then to the public through sales, sealed bids, and auctions.

vermont.how: Vermont's Surplus Property office holds vehicle and heavy equipment auctions and online auctions.

virginia.how: Virginia's Office of Surplus Property Management holds live auctions around the state and online auctions open to the public.

washington.how: Washington's Department of Enterprise Services sells surplus as buy-now items and online auctions, and also lists surplus real estate.

west-virginia.how: The West Virginia State Agency for Surplus Property sells mainly through online auctions and from its facility in Dunbar.

wisconsin.how: Wisconsin agencies offer surplus to other agencies and municipalities first, then to the public through several sale channels.

wyoming.how: Wyoming Surplus Property redistributes and resells items from state agencies through online sales.
